title: TRCF: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2611.26351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting supports healthcare monitoring, environmental analysis, and activity recognition. Channel-independent (CI) approaches capture each variable's temporal patterns but do not explicitly use observations from other variables. Channel-dependent (CD) modeling exploits relationships among variables, yet asynchronous measurements make these relationships difficult to learn. Incorporating cross-variable information while preserving each variable's irregular history therefore remains a key challenge. We propose Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting (TRCF), a framework that augments a compact CI forecaster with a complementary CD branch. ANCHOR aggregates observed values and timestamps at shared temporal locations, retaining observation support to form compact CI features. translated_title: TRCF：面向不规则多变量时间序列的时序-参考互补预测
translated_abstract: 不规则多变量时间序列预测支持医疗健康监测、环境分析和活动识别等应用。通道独立（CI）方法能够捕捉每个变量的时间模式，但不会显式利用来自其他变量的观测信息。通道依赖（CD）建模利用变量之间的关系，然而异步测量使这些关系难以学习。因此，在保留每个变量不规则历史的同时融合跨变量信息仍然是一个关键挑战。我们提出了时序-参考互补预测（TRCF），这是一个用互补的通道依赖分支来增强紧凑通道独立预测器的框架。其中，ANCHOR在共享时间位置上聚合观测值和时间戳，保留观测支撑以形成紧凑的通道独立特征；BRIDGE通过历史补全构建互补特征，首先估计每个变量的历史值……
tldr: TRCF框架通过将紧凑的通道独立预测器与互补的通道依赖分支相结合，利用ANCHOR和BRIDGE两个模块在保留不规则观测历史的同时融合跨变量信息，从而改进不规则多变量时间序列的预测。
en_tdlr: TRCF augments a compact channel-independent forecaster with a complementary channel-dependent branch, using ANCHOR and BRIDGE modules to incorporate cross-variable information while preserving irregular observation histories for improved irregular multivariate time series forecasting.
